intro: Find all of our rules using the dropdown below. Please review them before taking part. Breaking these rules will result in moderation!
note: Failure to follow these rules will result in moderation. — Hawaii Studio

sections.name: Discord Rules
sections.description: How everyone is expected to act
rules: Respect everyone. No harassment, hate speech, or discrimination.
No spamming, excessive caps, or mass pinging.
Keep content SFW. No NSFW, gore, or disturbing content.
Staff decisions are final. Appeal through a ticket, not in public chat.

sections.name: Voice Chat Rules
rules: No loud noises, soundboards, or voice changers that disrupt others.
Don't talk over people or interrupt on purpose.
Don't record anyone without their permission.
Keep music in the music channels.

sections.name: Studio Rules
rules: Never share or leak studio work, assets, or code without permission.
Give credit when you use someone else's work.
No stealing, reuploading, or reselling assets.
Keep project discussion in the right channels.

sections.name: Support & Tickets
sections.description: How to get help from staff
rules: Open a ticket for help instead of DMing staff.
One ticket per issue, and please be patient.
Explain your issue clearly and include screenshots if you can.
Don't open tickets as a joke. Misuse will result in moderation.
